recovery_metric_definitions.parameter_relative_l2: RMS of eight individual relative parameter errors
recovery_metric_definitions.parameter_log_rmse: RMS of eight log(estimate/truth) parameter errors
recovery_metric_definitions.parameter_mean_relative_error: Mean absolute relative error across eight parameters
recovery_metric_definitions.latent_relative_l2: Pooled relative L2 across all nine states at the 80 test-bin right endpoints
recovery_metric_definitions.state_nrmse: Mean of nine state RMSEs normalized separately by true training-state RMS
recovery_metric_definitions.latent_E_H_U_M1_M2_nrmse: Same separately normalized metric restricted to E, H, U, M1, M2
